title: Self-powered piezoelectric microfluidic flow sensor for low-flow monitoring of metal-ion solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19842-19850
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02026G, Paper
Open Access

Yunzheng Zhang, Tao Wang, Jun Zheng, Wenjin Luo, Zhangjun Lan, Binyou Xie, Shushu Chen, Xinming Xia, Liuhua Mu, Jie Jiang, Yan Fan, Liang Chen
A self-powered piezoelectric microfluidic flow sensor enables stable monitoring of metal-ion solutions at ultralow flow rates. With a PDMS isolation membrane and piezoelectric film, it delivers sensitive, rapid, and power-free detection.
